about_the_game:
🏪 Store Life Simulator – Build Your Market Empire!

Store Life Simulator is a simulation and management game where you start with a small store and must expand it into a true retail empire! Hire employees, manage your stock, serve customers, and open new shops while tackling the daily challenges of an entrepreneur.

🛒 Manage Your Store

  • Control customer flow and keep your shelves stocked.

  • Set product prices and maximize your profits.

  • Expand your shop to attract more customers and boost sales.

🏠 Go Home and Rest

  • Each day ends when you close the store and return home.

  • Time only advances when you sleep, allowing for strategic planning.

  • New challenges and opportunities arise every morning!

👥 Hire and Manage Employees

  • Add cashiers to speed up customer service.

  • Hire stock clerks to keep the shelves full.

  • Employ janitors to ensure the store stays clean.

  • Hire security guards to prevent theft and maintain order.

🏬 Expand Your Business

  • Purchase new stores and customize their names and visual identity.

  • Manage multiple locations at once and become a retail tycoon!

🎨 Low Poly Graphics

  • A charming, stylized look that enhances your experience.

  • Lively and dynamic environments with NPCs interacting realistically.

Get ready to take on the challenges of running a store and growing your business in Store Life Simulator! 🚀
